about_the_game: A free set of 4 fast horse that shined in the Showa era, including Katsuragi Ace, the first Japanese horse to win the Japan Cup, Nihon Pillow Winner, a horse that was unmatched in short distance races, Sakura Yutaka O, a horse who, as its name suggests, had speed that will be talked about in future generations, and Soccer Boy, a horse that charmed the crowd with its strong legs.
